about: A solo practitioner and the founder of The Law Offices of Matthew R. Gebhardt, P.C., Matthew R. Gebhardt has been practicing law in Illinois since 1999. Extensively experienced in multiple niches of law, including criminal and real estate, he has represented clients facing various accusations, including drug charges, DUI, retail theft, sex crimes, traffic law crimes and juvenile offenses.

With a Bachelor of Science degree in political science, Mr. Gebhardt graduated from DePaul University in 1996. After finishing his undergraduate studies, he joined the Chicago-Kent College of Law and earned his Juris Doctor in 1999, thereby receiving his bar license the same year.

Mr. Gebhardt started his legal career at the Cook County State’s Attorney’s Office as a legal prosecutor and served the people of the Greater Chicago area for more than half a decade. With the knowledge and experience he gained while working as a prosecutor, he decided to establish his own firm to personally attend to those who have been falsely accused of crimes. In the month of October of 2003, he founded his legal practice, and since then he has been providing legal assistance to his clients.

Placing great emphasis on personally connecting and communicating with all of his clients, Mr. Gebhardt understands the potential pitfalls of inadequate communication. He maintains a strong commitment to promptly returning phone calls, text messages and emails, and ensures to keep his clients well-informed of developments in their case.
Mr. Gebhardt was honored by The National Trial Lawyers by including him in their Top 100 Trial Lawyers list and is also rated "Superb" on Avvo.
